title: Common definitions
description: Shared definitions of the harness delegation contract, version 1. Other schemas reference these entries by URN.

state.description: Lifecycle state of a delegation run.

terminal_state.description: Lifecycle state from which a run has no outgoing transition.

failed_reason.description: Closed list of reasons that accompany the failed state.

input_required_cause.description: Cause that accompanies the input_required pause.

auth_required_cause.description: Cause that accompanies the auth_required pause.

activity_source.description: Observed source of the last liveness signal: an agent update or the child process.

run_id.description: Run identifier assigned by the broker, 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.

trace_id.description: W3C-style trace identifier: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, not all zeros.

span_id.description: Span identifier: 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters, not all zeros.

cursor.description: Position in a run's event log. Starts at 0 for reading and the first event has cursor 1.

schema_version.description: Version of the contract the document follows. This contract version is 1.

abs_path.description: Absolute path: POSIX (leading slash), Windows drive (letter, colon, separator) or UNC (two leading backslashes). Existence is checked by the broker.

nullable_string.description: Non-empty string, or null when the value is not available. Null is distinct from an empty string and from zero.
